Understanding angle relationships and measurement is important for many trades and professions.
Trigonometry introduces a unit of angle measurement called a radian which is based on a circle.
Further study will show that the relationship between the sides and angles of a triangle are described with functions such as sine and cosine.
Trigonometry will teach you how to graph these functions on two different types of coordinate systems.

DISCUSSION
Let's start with the terms point, line segment, ray, and angle.
A point is the simplest geometric component. A point is usually shown as a dot and labeled with a capital letter.
A line segment includes two endpoints and all of the points in between. Line segments are named by using the endpoints.
A ray has one endpoint and extends to infinity in the other direction. Rays are named using the endpoint and any other point which the ray passes through.
An angle is formed by two rays joined at the same endpoint. The endpoint is called the vertex and the rays are the sides.
Angles can be named three different ways. Any one of these names can be used for this angle.
Greek letters are often used to name angles.
